svg.title: Lighter without losing anything: the measured baseline and the guards that keep it lossless
svg.desc: Measured on the project's machine: the whole Python suite about 21 minutes for 6,118 test cases, the frontend check about 25 s, importing the service core 0.77 s and 176 MB, 147,234 lines of Python source. Now in main: the agent workbench component split from 1,699 to 1,343 lines, a test selector that missed none of 619 deletion scenarios, and an inventory that fails when any route, command, setting, page or test disappears. No before-and-after timing is claimed.
